concepts.title: A — Vidro escuro
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a high fidelity native desktop app design proposal, front-on flat application screenshot, landscape 16:9, crisp readable Portuguese labels. NOT a website, NOT a device photograph.
Primary request: design the future fullscreen Windows and Linux media download/conversion app UIfor_yt-dlp. Show one sophisticated, exceptionally organized dark frosted-glass application occupying the entire canvas. It must look feasible to implement with Qt, with subtle layered glass, not a fantasy 3D render.
Style: quiet contemporary native desktop utility, a restrained interpretation of translucent Apple-style utility chrome. Deep graphite/navy background #10151F, restrained blue-grey diffused light INSIDE the application backdrop, frosted panels #1C2533 at high opacity, extremely subtle thin highlights, blue #4D9CFF for the single action accent, white #F4F7FB text, muted #B6C2D2 text. Glass translucency should be visible in panel edges without reducing text contrast. No rainbow, purple nebula, strong glow or decorative giant shapes. Modern system sans typography similar to Segoe UI/Inter, medium weight headings, exact alignment.
Composition: app header across the top, 64px tall, left a modest original download outline icon and exact product title "UIfor_yt-dlp". Below title small descriptive line "Vídeos, áudio e GIFs". Right two understated labeled utility actions "Sobre" and an outline fullscreen control "Sair da tela inteira". No operating-system dock or desktop wallpaper. 40px comfortable outer margins. Content occupies 90% of canvas, no huge empty space. Beneath header, section title "Novo download" with small subtitle "Cole um link e escolha como salvar." Main working area two columns: left roughly 60% width, right 40%, 24px gutter. Two main panels, not a dashboard of tiny cards. Both high-opacity frosted surfaces with 18px corners and carefully disciplined spacing.
Left panel, top to bottom: label "Link da mídia", one wide editable field containing "https://exemplo.com/video" with a small neutral link outline icon and "Colar" button at the trailing edge. Next label "Formato de saída", six equally readable format choices in one row "MP4", "MP3", "WEBM", "MKV", "GIF", "WAV"; MP4 clearly selected with a blue border and quiet blue tint. Helper text "Melhor qualidade disponível". Next label "Pasta de destino", a wide path field with folder outline icon, exact text "Downloads", small action "Alterar". Then an unchecked option "Baixar playlist" and small help "Quando o link incluir uma lista". At bottom a wide blue primary control labelled "Baixando…" with a small spinner, disabled since one download is running. Fields have subdued disabled appearance while still completely legible.
Right panel: heading "Download em andamento", below an original SMALL abstract media thumbnail, a generic landscape still with no recognizable third-party content, filename "Vídeo de exemplo.mp4", one-line badge "MP4 · Vídeo". Larger clear percentage "62%", thin elegant blue progress bar, then exact text "Baixando vídeo". A compact single metadata line "148 MB de 239 MB". A quiet divider and explanatory text "A conversão começa após o download." Show no pause or cancel control: these are not currently supported. Beneath this panel a quiet link-style action "Abrir pasta" only if it is visually disabled during the ongoing operation. No charts, historical list or fake queue.
Bottom app footer subtle, aligned, exact "UIfor_yt-dlp" left and "Sobre • GPLv3" right, nothing more.
Constraints: all exact labels carefully spelled in Portuguese; do not call this YouTube Downloader or Baixar Música YouTube. No platform logo rows or claims of certified site support. No accounts, subscriptions, AI download assistant, history, queues, quality sliders, cancel, pause or social branding. Distinguish selected elements precisely. Maintain a practical high contrast utility UI with 48px control heights, visible focus outlines, realistic compact icon scale, no excessive pill buttons. This is a concept illustration with fictitious download data; do not add any explanatory labels about AI generation inside the product.

concepts.title: B — Vidro claro
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a high fidelity native desktop app design proposal, front-on flat application screenshot, landscape 16:9, crisp readable Portuguese labels. NOT a website or photographed device.
Primary request: the light-mode alternative for the fullscreen Windows and Linux media download/conversion utility UIfor_yt-dlp. Show one beautiful quiet pearlescent frosted-glass application occupying the entire canvas, with practical readable controls. This must be a realistic native Qt implementation direction.
Style: modern crystal/frosted glass, warm-white #F4F6FA canvas, extremely subtle blue-grey atmosphere inside the app background, high-opacity pearl-white panels, hairline slate-grey borders, blue #0066CC as single action accent, ink #18212D for all primary text, muted #526277 for secondary text. Tiny shadows only where necessary to distinguish surfaces. Glass effects should be visible in restrained edge highlights, not shiny 3D jelly. System sans typography similar to Segoe UI/Inter. No purple, rainbow, neon, Apple logos, or proprietary OS imitation.
Layout: a 64px app header, product title "UIfor_yt-dlp" and a small original download outline glyph left, descriptive line "Vídeos, áudio e GIFs". Right utilities "Sobre" and a fullscreen outline icon with exact text "Sair da tela inteira". No taskbar, OS desktop wallpaper or browser navigation. 40px outer margins and a wide workspace occupying 90% of the screen, with disciplined 24px spacing. Section title "Novo download" and caption "Cole um link e escolha como salvar." Two main panels only, left 60% for configuration, right 40% for status.
Left panel: label "Link da mídia" and single wide field "https://exemplo.com/video", neutral link icon, small trailing "Colar" button. Label "Formato de saída", six format choices in one row "MP4", "MP3", "WEBM", "MKV", "GIF", "WAV", MP4 selected blue border and pale-blue tint. Readonly helper "Melhor qualidade disponível". Label "Pasta de destino", folder icon, field "Downloads", compact "Alterar" action. An unchecked "Baixar playlist" option with helper "Quando o link incluir uma lista". A wide primary blue control at bottom labelled "Baixando…" with spinner, disabled while download is running. Configuration slightly subdued for the active operation, still readable.
Right panel: heading "Download em andamento". A small original thumbnail of generic landscape media, "Vídeo de exemplo.mp4", secondary badge "MP4 · Vídeo". Clear large "62%", blue progress bar, state "Baixando vídeo", text "148 MB de 239 MB". Divider and calm message "A conversão começa após o download." No cancel or pause button. Small inactive link action "Abrir pasta" below.
Footer: "UIfor_yt-dlp" at bottom left, "Sobre • GPLv3" bottom right.
Constraints: Portuguese labels must be sharp and accurately spelled, no wording that restricts the app to YouTube or music. No platform logo row, no certified-sites claims, no history, download queue, accounts, cloud services, AI execution features, quality sliders, cancellation or pause. Use at least 48px tall controls and comfortable readable body copy, careful selected states and focus. This is an alternate VISUAL theme for the same functional layout, not a marketing landing page. Only fictitious download data in the conceptual screen, do not show annotations about implementation inside the app.

concepts.title: C — Adaptação do vidro escuro
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a native software responsive-layout concept presentation, front-facing 16:9 landscape design sheet with exactly TWO UI screenshots side by side, a compact resizable desktop app LEFT taking about 68% of width, and an Android portrait screen RIGHT taking about 27%. High fidelity, legible Portuguese labels, no photographed monitor, no perspective, no decorative phone hardware.
Primary request: demonstrate how the proposed UIfor_yt-dlp dark frosted-glass media downloader adapts to a smaller Windows/Linux window and an Android phone. The desktop is NOT forced to be fullscreen; it is a normal resizable window. Phone already uses its normal full app area. This is one shared visual language.
Style: restrained dark glass, graphite/navy #10151F, high-opacity frosted panels #1C2533, quiet blue-grey atmospheric background inside the app, single action blue #4D9CFF, primary text white #F4F7FB, secondary text #B6C2D2. No purple, neon, glossy jelly or strong decorative glow. Modern clear system sans. On the sheet outside the actual app screenshots use two small clear headings "Janela menor · Windows / Linux" and "Android".
Desktop: small native-looking title bar with "UIfor_yt-dlp", minimize, maximize and close icons. Within app header "UIfor_yt-dlp", smaller "Vídeos, áudio e GIFs", discreet "Sobre" icon. Single-column content to demonstrate the narrow layout, with normal vertical scrolling rather than squeezed side-by-side panels. Clear title "Novo download". A main frosted panel: label "Link da mídia", a wide empty field placeholder "Cole o link aqui" and small trailing "Colar". Label "Formato de saída" and six compact choices on two rows if needed "MP4", "MP3", "WEBM", "MKV", "GIF", "WAV", GIF selected with blue border. Because GIF is selected display exact heading "Intervalo do GIF", two readable side-by-side time fields labelled "Início" and "Fim", values "00:01" and "00:03". Helper text "Trecho de até 30 segundos". Next "Pasta de destino", value "Downloads", "Alterar". Wide blue primary action "Gerar GIF". Below a compact progress panel state "Aguardando" and empty thin progress bar. No active download. Show the lower part fully rather than clipping the button.
Android: same product title, "Novo download", single-column stacked compact panel, "Link da mídia", placeholder "Cole o link aqui", small "Colar". "Formato de saída", a dropdown reading "GIF · Animação" (six formats available but only current selection visible). "Intervalo do GIF", two side-by-side labelled fields "Início" value "00:01" and "Fim" value "00:03", helper "Até 30 segundos". An informational save row "Salvar em Downloads" (do not offer an arbitrary folder picker on Android). Wide blue "Gerar GIF" action. Compact empty status area with "Aguardando". Small footer "Sobre • GPLv3". Typical Android status bar at top and gesture navigation indicator at bottom, no brand logos. Controls at least 48dp high, respecting system safe areas. Narrow screens should stack rather than crush or hide critical controls.
Constraints: exact title UIfor_yt-dlp everywhere; no YouTube Downloader text, no media services badges, fake certified support, queues, history, accounts, AI runtime, cancellation, pause, resolution slider or undocumented extra features. No giant empty space. Both screens are idle with no download running. Show clean focus/selected outlines, consistent 16px corner geometry and readable text. Maintain original simple download/conversion functions with the GIF interval conditionally visible.

revisions.title: A — Vidro escuro com alternância
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-fidelity native desktop UI mockup revision.
Input image: edit target; existing UIfor_yt-dlp DARK glass fullscreen app design.
Change ONLY the top app header to include a theme switcher. Preserve the entire composition, aspect ratio, palette, text, typography, panels, progress data, media thumbnail and every field below the header pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. The app title and subtitle at left remain exact and unchanged.
In the header's right side, insert a compact two-segment theme selector BEFORE the existing "Sobre" and "Sair da tela inteira" actions. The selector has exact labels "Claro" and "Escuro", optionally a tiny sun and moon outline icon. In THIS DARK screenshot "Escuro" is selected with a restrained blue outline/tint; "Claro" is unselected. Make the existing right header actions slightly more compact ONLY if necessary so the group fits naturally without overlap. Keep the original glass style and high contrast. Do not add a second selector anywhere.
No other edits. Do not introduce settings page, accounts, AI execution feature, platform badges, menus, extra download options, cancel or pause. Sharp accurate Portuguese text. This is the selected dark theme of one app with both light and dark appearance.

revisions.title: Tema escuro — janela maximizada
revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: native desktop UI mockup correction, not an app implementation.
Input image is the edit target: dark UIfor_yt-dlp glass desktop app with Claro/Escuro selector.
Correct ONLY how the application occupies the screen and the fullscreen header action. The user wants a STANDARD MAXIMIZED APPLICATION, respecting the operating-system taskbar, not immersive fullscreen.
Remove the entire app header action "Sair da tela inteira", its fullscreen brackets icon and separator. Retain the Claro/Escuro theme selector, Escuro selected, and "Sobre"; align this small group neatly at the right of the app header.
Add a slim ordinary native dark WINDOW TITLE BAR across the very top, above the app header, with small app title "UIfor_yt-dlp" left, and conventional minimize, RESTORE (overlapping-square) and close buttons right. The restore icon indicates a maximized window. These are standard system title-bar controls, not special in-app fullscreen buttons.
Add a visible modest ordinary Windows TASKBAR along the bottom of the image, outside the app: simple system/pinned glyphs centered, a quiet clock area right, no identifiable third-party application logos. The maximized app fills the full usable screen width and all available height BETWEEN title bar and taskbar; absolutely no desktop margin around the app and no floating small window.
Keep the original app form, columns, glass palette, media thumbnail, all Portuguese text, six formats, percentage 62%, blue progress bar and theme selector unchanged as closely as possible. Fit the existing app body proportionately in the space above the taskbar. Maintain readability and do not crop or cover any of the app's controls or footer.
No fullscreen label, no fullscreen icon, no F11, no Esc shortcut hint anywhere. No other features, visual redesign or newly invented menus. The thumbnail is still illustrative. This is a faithful update showing standard maximization and a visible system taskbar.
